name: Custom Breakthrough
description:
BREAKTHROUGH: Attackers vs. Defenders. Attackers win by capturing objectives. Sector by sector. Defenders win by eliminating all enemy reinforcements. Recommended for 64 players.
Listed below are levels that have been pre-configured to immediately work with this Breakthrough Template once imported into the Battlefield 6 Web Builder.
To use your custom levels, you will need to export them and upload them to the web-builder separately.
